rows.rationale: Retains three divine names and repeated vengeance rather than softening the opening.
rows.before: A jealous and avenging God is the LORD; the LORD avenges and is master of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on adversaries and keeps wrath for enemies.
rows.after: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God; the LORD avenges and is full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on his adversaries and reserves wrath for his enemies.
rows.tsw_comparator: A jealous and avenging God is the LORD; the LORD avenges and is master of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on adversaries and keeps wrath for enemies.

rows.rationale: Keeps patience alongside accountability and ancient storm/feet imagery.
rows.before: The LORD is slow to anger and great in power, but the LORD will certainly not leave the guilty unpunished. The LORD's way is in whirlwind and storm, and clouds are the dust of the LORD's feet.
rows.after: The LORD is slow to anger and great in power, but he will certainly not leave guilt unpunished. The LORD’s way is in whirlwind and storm; clouds are the dust of his feet.
rows.tsw_comparator: The LORD is slow to anger and great in power, but the LORD will certainly not leave the guilty unpunished. The LORD's way is in whirlwind and storm, and clouds are the dust of the LORD's feet.

rows.rationale: Retains all waters and three fertile regions with repeated withering.
rows.before: The LORD rebukes the sea and dries it up and makes all the rivers dry. Bashan and Carmel wither, and the blossom of Lebanon withers.
rows.after: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; he makes all the rivers run dry. Bashan and Carmel wither; Lebanon’s blossoms wither.
rows.tsw_comparator: The LORD rebukes the sea and dries it up and makes all the rivers dry. Bashan and Carmel wither, and the blossom of Lebanon withers.
